title: Media studio capture plan
description: Interaction-first capture plan. product-picture.md is the contract. PNG plates are diagnostic, not the picture of a screen beat.

kind.description: hold is last-frame of the preceding WebM, not a PNG and not a skipped interaction.

trace.description: Playwright trace.zip path. Metadata only; never the encoded picture.

locator.description: Playwright locator or named control for an interaction beat.

expectedResult.description: Visible product response that proves the action.

startState.description: What is visibly true before the action. Must differ from resultState.

resultState.description: What is visibly true after the product responds.

provesClaim.description: The narration claim this take proves on screen.

clip.description: Relative path to a WebM/MP4 under capture/. Not a PNG for interaction.

plateName.description: Diagnostic still or poster only. Never the encoded picture of an interaction beat.
